title: Kobe Bryant: How Basketball Players Build Their Skills
summary: Kobe Bryant played 20 years for the Los Angeles Lakers and won five NBA championships. Muggsy Bogues and Spud Webb were very short, but they were stars too.

blocks.title: Introduction

blocks.title: Part 1: Who Kobe Bryant was
paragraphs: Kobe Bryant was a famous basketball player. He was born on August 23, 1978. He played for the Los Angeles Lakers. The Los Angeles Lakers are a team in the NBA. The NBA is the big basketball league in the United States. Kobe Bryant played 20 years in the NBA. He played all 20 years with the same team, the Los Angeles Lakers. That is a long time with one team. Kobe Bryant died on January 26, 2020. Many people still remember him.

images.alt: A focused young player in a plain purple and gold practice jersey holds a basketball alone on an empty indoor court.

blocks.title: Check: Part 1: Who Kobe Bryant was

items.prompt: How many years did Kobe Bryant play with the Los Angeles Lakers?
items.answer: He played 20 years with the Los Angeles Lakers. It was his whole NBA career.

blocks.title: Part 2: The big wins of Kobe Bryant
paragraphs: Kobe Bryant won a lot. He won five NBA championships with the Los Angeles Lakers. A championship means the team was the best team that year. In 2008, he was the NBA MVP. MVP means the most valuable player, the best player of the season. In 1997, he won the Slam Dunk Contest. In the Slam Dunk Contest, players jump high and try big dunks. Kobe Bryant also played for the U.S. team. He won two Olympic gold medals, in 2008 and in 2012.

blocks.title: Check: Part 2: The big wins of Kobe Bryant

items.prompt: In which years did Kobe Bryant win Olympic gold medals?
items.answer: He won Olympic gold medals in 2008 and 2012 with the U.S. team.

blocks.title: Part 3: Mamba Mentality
paragraphs: People called Kobe Bryant the Black Mamba. A black mamba is a fast, strong snake. The name shows how he played. From this name comes the idea of Mamba Mentality. Mamba Mentality means work hard every day and keep trying. It is not only about game day. It is about every practice, every morning, every small step. A student in a school club can use Mamba Mentality too. Come to practice every day. Try again after a miss. Get a little better each time.

images.alt: A young player practices alone early in a bright gym, dribbling near a plain hoop with a towel on a bench.

items.prompt: What does Mamba Mentality mean in simple words?
items.answer: Mamba Mentality means work hard every day and keep trying, not only on game day.
items.explanation: What is one thing you could practice every day for one month, and how would you keep going on a tired day?

blocks.title: Part 4: Muggsy Bogues, the shortest NBA player
paragraphs: Basketball players are often very tall. Muggsy Bogues was not. He was about 5 feet 3 inches tall, or 1.60 meters. He is the shortest player ever in the NBA. He was born on January 9, 1965. He played 14 seasons in the NBA. He played about 10 seasons with the Charlotte Hornets. He was a point guard. A point guard starts the plays and passes the ball. Muggsy Bogues was strong at passes and steals. He did not need height. He used speed and smart hands.

blocks.title: Check: Part 4: Muggsy Bogues, the shortest NBA player

items.prompt: How tall is Muggsy Bogues, and what was he strong at?
items.answer: He is about 5 feet 3 inches, or 1.60 meters. He was strong at passes and steals.

blocks.title: Part 5: Spud Webb and the big dunk
paragraphs: Spud Webb was also short. He is about 5 feet 7 inches tall, or 1.70 meters. He was born on July 13, 1963. He was a point guard, like Muggsy Bogues. He played for the Atlanta Hawks and other teams. In 1986, Spud Webb won the NBA Slam Dunk Contest. A short man beat the tall players at jumping. So two short stars show two paths. Muggsy Bogues used skill, passes, and steals. Spud Webb used big jumps and dunks. Both worked hard every day. Both used Mamba Mentality before the name existed.

images.alt: A clearly shorter player dunks toward a plain hoop while two much taller players watch from the side.

blocks.title: Check: Part 5: Spud Webb and the big dunk

items.prompt: What did Spud Webb win in 1986, and why is that surprising?
items.answer: He won the NBA Slam Dunk Contest in 1986. It is surprising because he is only about 5 feet 7 inches tall.

items.prompt: Muggsy Bogues used skill and Spud Webb used jumping. In your own life, do you like to win with careful skill or with a big bold move, and why?
